PDF.js 3.11.174, from the npm package pdfjs-dist (https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js), Apache License 2.0 - see
LICENSE beside this file. Unchanged: build/pdf.min.js and build/pdf.worker.min.js as published.

Built into Burnos.exe as Qt resources (web.qrc). The hidden browser (webbrowser.cpp) runs them inside the page
when the address a task opened is a PDF, to read the words out of it: a browser shows a PDF, but has no words of
it to hand over.
